dependencies.description: One bot-coordination experimental program; treatment arms and alternative editions are not separate independent confirmations.
One route-optimization program. Visibility and storage conditions and repeated trials share a design; trial observations are not unique people.
One cultural-accumulation experiment with complementary paths embedded in its payoff landscape; observations share treatment design.
One fixed-degree network experiment. Network efficiency is the manipulated topology property; do not rename it complete connectivity.
The meta-analysis aggregates earlier samples. The mean and variability estimates use different sample sets; neither is independent of its underlying studies, which were not re-audited.
The synthesis explicitly reuses Derex and Boyd and Mason and Watts. Those references add interpretation, not new participant-data roots. It does not establish a third replication of either result.
Interpretation compares the synthesis's defined construct and network paraphrase with the primary experiment's fixed degree. The comparison is editorial reasoning, not newly collected data.
Agent compositions share a swarm-optimization model and synthetic search environment. Repeated simulation runs are not human replications; the personality mapping remains a modeling assumption.

license.source_material: Source works retain their recorded licenses. Only attributed minimal excerpts and original descriptions are included; no full source payloads are distributed.

limitations: This is a purposive seven-work audit seeded by an earlier AI-assisted landscape, not a systematic review. Selection and interpretation may omit relevant contradictory or confirming studies.
The participant experiments manipulate different interventions and measure different outcomes. No common causal effect, meta-analytic average, or global vote count is computed.

Four experimental programs are described, not four replications of a personality-mixture claim. Participant identities and raw data have not been audited for overlap; no statistical independence beyond the documented program distinctions is asserted.
Published findings and exact passages were checked, and reported arithmetic or table values were reproduced. No primary dataset, meta-analysis, or simulation was rerun.

Short excerpts locate evidence within the named paragraph or table; a reviewer must inspect that context. Typography normalization expands ligatures, joins line-break hyphens, and collapses whitespace. Peeters Table 2 is transcribed visually because its text layer corrupts mathematical characters.

Calculation pointers name exact printed table cells or paragraph fields in RFC-6901-style form; they are semantic locators for PDFs, not a claim that the publisher distributes a corresponding JSON data object.
Source bytes are not redistributed. Sources without a confirmed reuse license are marked unknown; short attributed excerpts total at most twenty-five words per work.

The preparation timestamp records the CLI bundle phase. Orientation, candidate-source discovery, and assistance from two same-lineage research agents began earlier; all credited artifact captures occurred after preparation.

All assisting agents share authoring context and model family. Their research and preflight checks supply no independent-review or scientific-evidence credit. The proposed reading requires a separately rooted reviewer under the repository's accepted rules.

A draft submission is a non-admitting queue item. It cannot publish itself, alter accepted cases, or authorize promotion. Cost telemetry is unavailable; the trace's zero amount with unknown basis is not a claim that no compute was consumed.

scope.comparison_target: Does evidence that particular search or communication arrangements improve group outcomes establish that stable explorer-planner personality mixtures are necessary or outperform equally capable adaptive generalists? The selected works support conditional mechanisms but do not settle that stronger comparison. This is a scoped inference, not evidence that enduring explorers have no value.
scope.excluded: An exhaustive landscape review; a meta-analysis across these heterogeneous tasks; direct estimates of societal welfare; a claim that exploration requires low conscientiousness or poor dependability; an optimal percentage of explorers; new simulations or participant-data reanalysis.
scope.included: A bounded audit of seven selected works linking exploration, communication, and group problem solving to claims about enduring human personality diversity. It compares four experimental programs, one personality meta-analysis, one synthesis, and one simulation. Proposed reader title: Does society need explorers?

search_notes: Repository orientation used AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, make orient, repo next, the public agent research protocol, EM-0040 and its execution plan, and subsequent intake hardening. This uses the already implemented public submission path; it does not claim to rerun or complete the historical Claude cold-start pilot.

Prior-art check: live discovery and open-docket index list four accepted cases: correction familiarity/backfire, research-agent citation dependence, GPT-4 bar-exam percentiles, and Mehrabian communication weights. The reviewed climate-consensus docket compares survey/abstract quantities. This proposal shares auditing methods with those records but has a different subject, evidence, and comparison target.

Accepted repository base 4e86baffc3dc84a7cdc14668c651233ecd2b75d8 was inspected directly. Its four dossier JSON files and one reviewed open-docket proposal contain no exploration/personality claim. Live site discovery still identifies f92846570180dfa4511263f8ba98ecd18f7772c9; repository base and deployed projection are not silently equated.

Open PR inspection found docket submissions #69 (Llama licensing), #72 (GPT-4 bar exam), and #82 (climate consensus). Other open PRs #34, #73, and #93 concern implementation. None covers or closely restates the exploration/personality question. This is repository prior-art screening, not a claim of scientific novelty.

Primary-source verification used publisher, author, and institutional editions. Searches covered the exact titles, intervention descriptions, results, counterevidence, and limitations. The seven credited PDF artifacts were downloaded and hashed independently of search snippets.

The prior AI landscape supplied leads only. Its broad narrative, bibliography size, and agreement among assisting agents are not counted as evidence. The contributor retained negative results and relevant limits instead of importing the full landscape as a finished verdict.

The Smaldino synthesis explicitly reuses Derex and Boyd and Mason and Watts. Its Shore/Bernstein/Lazer reference is a different earlier study; no dependence on Bernstein 2018 or Shirado 2017 is claimed.

The primary Nature PDF contains an additional disclosed-bot study absent from the earlier manuscript edition consulted for orientation. Only the Figure 2 central-low-noise versus human-only comparison is quantified here; editions are not counted as separate works.

Recommended interpretation: some groups benefit from protected exploration or well-chosen behavioral variation. The evidence in this packet does not establish that society requires permanent explorer personality types. Institutional arrangements and persistent individual differences remain distinct candidate mechanisms.

unresolved: Whether persistent specialist differences outperform matched adaptive generalists after holding competence, resources, communication, and implementation opportunities comparable.
Whether everyday nonplanning, spontaneity, or low orderliness predicts beneficial exploratory behavior independently of openness, persistence, and reliability.
How to aggregate discovery, implementation, coordination costs, unequal rewards, and harmful failures into an explicit measure of societal benefit.
External validity across longer horizons, changing environments, costly mistakes, and institutions. No universal share of explorers is inferred.
The proposed specialist-versus-adaptive-generalist comparison is a research direction, not a claim of novelty established by this bounded audit.
